_comment: A16A1 Power Amplifier Digital Control SIP PCA -- test point expectations.
There are none. The board carries no test points on its drawing or its
sheet (5700A-1071), no Chapter 2 supply table covers it, and Chapter 5
has no section for it. Its rails are the +5LH / +5RLH logic supplies from
A17 arriving on P2, listed here so the rail legend has something to name.
Fault codes 3500-3503, 3521 and 3530 are the published procedure and are

LH.label: +5 LH guarded logic supply (from A17 via A16 P702 and P2)

CTRL.label: Control lines to A16 and A18 (LC0*-LC7*, C0*-C7*, CONT0*-CONT7*, SW0-SW7)

probePoints.label: U11 pin 35 -- RESET
probePoints.condition: Power on, after the instrument has finished its power-up sequence
probePoints.source: Sheet 1 (5700A-1071): RESET from P2 through R102/C54 and R101/C53; §2-140; fault code 3530
probePoints.note: The 82C55 reset pin. Fault code 3530 fires when the control word has been lost, which means this pin has been high since the software last wrote it. Anything above a TTL low here while the instrument is running points at the RC network on the reset line or at the guarded digital bus rather than at U11.
